---
title: "Process no-flow data"
---


```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cli)
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
data <- bind_rows(
  nanoparquet::read_parquet(proj_path("processed_dir", 'stiff_fin_sps_data.parquet')),
  nanoparquet::read_parquet(proj_path("processed_dir", 'flex_fin_sps_data.parquet'))
)
```

```{r}
data <-
  data |> 
  rename(flowspeed.mmps = flowspeed.mm) |> 
  mutate(flowspeed.Lps = flowspeed.mmps/foillen.mm)
```

```{r}
data |> 
  group_by(fin, Amplitude, Frequency) |> 
  summarize(cycle_range = max(t.norm))
```

```{r}
data |> 
  mutate(fy_s.N = fy_s.N - fy.N_init) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = t.norm, y = fy_s.N, color = fin)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = trial)) +
  facet_wrap(~ flowspeed.Lps)
```

```{r}
forcedata <-
  data |> 
  mutate(fy.N_init = fy.N_init - bias_fy.N,
         fx.N_init = fx.N_init - bias_fx.N,
         tz.Nm_init = tz.Nm_init - bias_tz.Nm,
         fy_s.N = fy_s.N - bias_fy.N,
         fx_s.N = fx_s.N - bias_fx.N,
         tz_s.Nm = tz_s.Nm - bias_tz.Nm,
         angvel.degps = (lead(angle_cmd.deg) - lag(angle_cmd.deg)) / 
           (lead(t.s) - lag(t.s)))
```


```{r}
bias_offset_flex <-
  forcedata |> 
  filter(fin == 'flexible', flowspeed.mmps < 90) |> 
  group_by(trial) |> 
  summarize(across(ends_with("_init"), mean),
            .groups = 'drop') |> 
  summarize(across(ends_with("_init"),
                   \(x) x[trial == 2] - x[trial == 1]))

# this just duplicates the columns and appends the _s for the smoothed data
# since the bias offset is the same for smoothed and unsmoothed
bias_offset_flex <-
  bind_cols(
    bias_offset_flex,
    
    bias_offset_flex |> 
      rename_with(\(n) str_remove(n, '_init')),

    bias_offset_flex |> 
      rename_with(\(n) str_replace(n, '([ft][xyz])(\\.Nm?)_init', '\\1_s\\2'))
  )
```

```{r}
forcedatacorr <-
  forcedata |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    across(c(fy.N, fy_s.N, fy.N_init, fx.N_init),
                \(x) if_else(
                  (fin == 'flexible') & (trial >= 2),
                  x - bias_offset_flex[[cur_column()]],
                  x
                )
  )) |> 
  mutate(thrust_lateral(angle_cmd.deg, fx_s.N, fy_s.N),
         power.W = -tz_s.Nm * (angvel.degps * pi/180))
```

```{r}
forcedatacorr |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = t.norm, y = thrust.N)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = trial, color = fin)) +
  facet_wrap(~flowspeed.Lps)
```


Drag force is positive $f_y$, but we want to show it as negative.
```{r}
forcedatacorr |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = flowspeed.mmps, y = -fy.N_init, color = fin)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
forcedatacorr |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = flowspeed.mmps, y = fx.N_init, color = fin)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
forcemndata <-
  forcedatacorr |> 
  mutate(halfcycle = floor(t.norm*2)/2,
         cycle = floor(t.norm)) |> 
  filter(between(halfcycle, 2, 8)) |> 
  group_by(fin, trial, flowspeed.Lps, cycle) |> 
  summarize(fy_mn.N = mean(fy_s.N),
            peakthrust.N = signed_max(thrust.N, pctile = 0.99),
            meanthrust.N = mean(thrust.N),
            peaklateral.N = signed_max(thrust.N, pctile = 0.99),
            meanabslateral.N = mean(abs(lateral.N)),
            meanpower.W = mean(power.W),
            effect = meanthrust.N / meanpower.W,
            .groups = 'drop')
```

```{r}
forcemndata |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = flowspeed.Lps, x = meanthrust.N, color = fin)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)
```

```{r}
get_sps <- function(flowspeed.Lps, thrust.N)
{
  mod <- lm(flowspeed.Lps ~ thrust.N)
  predict(mod, newdata = tibble(thrust.N = 0),
          interval = 'confidence') |> 
    as_tibble()
}
```


```{r}
forcemndata |> 
  group_by(fin) |> 
  summarize(get_sps(flowspeed.Lps, meanthrust.N))  
```


```{r}
forcemndata |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = flowspeed.Lps, y = meanabslateral.N, color = fin)) +
  geom_point()
```
